name: FlowState
description: Local-first shared project memory for AI apps: an MIT MCP server that stores todos, changes, decisions, problems and learnings in SQLite on the user's machine. Reads keep Guard's usual handling; writes that reshape memory, rules, projects or the review queue are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: This entry matches the flowstate console script over stdio. Common python -m flowstate configs keep Guard's normal handling; point the harness at the flowstate binary to use these defaults.
start_here, search and manage_sessions(list/current) are read-oriented; log_work records work and can queue suggested=true items for the user's own FlowState review page.
manage_review (approve/reject/set_mode) stays on review so an agent cannot silently clear the human review queue or change review mode.
manage_projects delete, manage_memory delete/import and manage_data_git clone/sync/set_remote stay on review; FlowState already safety-copies before deletes.
DialectForge FlowState is installed from GitHub (setup_flowstate.py / pip install of the repo). The unrelated PyPI package named flowstate is not this server; do not uvx or pipx that name for it.
A separate paid Hosted endpoint (hosted.flowstatemcp.com/mcp) is remote HTTP and is not covered by this local direct-command entry.
